verdict.rationale: The README documents an update path for Antigravity: "Reinstall with the same command to update." Superpowers also ships through marketplaces (Claude Code plugin marketplace, Antigravity Marketplace manifest), but no evidence says those auto-update. The only documented path is re-running the install for one harness, not a dedicated update command or auto-update. Missing for 10: documented marketplace auto-update behavior, an explicit update command, and update instructions for the other supported harnesses (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, etc.).

support.subject: As a developer, there is a documented update path — marketplace auto-updates or an explicit update command — so I get fixes without reinstalling from scratch

citations.quote: Reinstall with the same command to update.
This release also adds a native plugin manifest for the Antigravity Marketplace
